title: The Storm Rises Again
next_chapter_hook: The countdown to March 7th has begun. Chen Nian's life hangs by that day—and in Chen Ji's hands, the first chess piece to pry open fate has finally been grasped!

text.content: The moment the token entered his hand, the three words 'Tianji Pavilion' struck like thunder—why would this mysterious force, existing only in ancient legends, have any connection to a废物杂役弟子's childhood? Chen Ji gazed at the ancient bronze token in his palm, its mottled patterns gleaming with a ghostly azure light under the morning sun, as if recounting a secret buried by time. On the back, a line of tiny characters was engraved: 'Tianji Pavilion Thirty-Seventh Generation Disciple · Chen.' His pupils constricted sharply—disciple on record, not an official disciple, the difference between these titles was thought-provoking. More bizarrely, the token's aura resonated faintly with the Tianji Record Fragment, as if two drops of blood from the same source. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently rippled within the Tianji Record, and an aged voice rang in his Mental Sea: 'This thing... where did you obtain it?' Rarely, there was a hint of trembling in his tone. Chen Ji slowly tucked the token into his robes, a meaningful smile curving his lips: 'Master, some answers might be more interesting than you imagine.'

Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, the morning bell melodious. The instant Chen Ji stepped out of the transfer array, he felt countless gazes prickling against his back like thorns. disciples returning from the secret realm gathered in clusters, their whispers occasionally carrying words like '废物', '杂役', '居然还活着'. He walked with downcast eyes and slightly hunched back, the very image of a man suppressed for over a decade. Yet as he passed the notice board, a golden list suddenly met his eyes—'Secret Realm Inner Sect Assessment Top Three: Chen Ji, reward doubled, promoted to Inner Sect!' The crowd exploded. 'What?! That废物?' 'Impossible! The list must be wrong!' 'What ability does he have, why him?' Chen Ji seemed deaf to these doubts, merely stumbling through the crowd with unsteady steps, occasionally 'accidentally' tripping, utterly disheveled. But at an angle unseen by others, the smile at his lips grew increasingly playful—these idiots, the harsher they cursed, the louder the slap would be when the time came.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji." A cold voice came from behind. Chen Ji's footsteps halted, and he turned to see Su Qingyao standing beneath the corridor in a moon-white gown, her cool brows and eyes carrying a hint of scrutiny. She approached slowly, her gaze like a blade sweeping over him, finally fixing on the slightly bulging spot in his chest. 'What did you obtain from the secret realm?' She was direct, her tone allowing no argument. Chen Ji scratched his head, wearing a simple, honest expression: 'R-reports, senior sister, just some spiritual herbs and ore, already submitted to the sect.' Su Qingyao's eyes flickered; she coldly hummed: 'You think I'm a three-year-old?' She stepped forward, the distance between them so close they could almost feel each other's breath. 'Your aura has changed, stronger by at least double compared to three months ago. And what's hidden in your chest—you think I can't see through it?' Chen Ji sighed inwardly—sure enough, this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's intuition was sharp. But on his face, he still wore an expression of helplessness, taking out the Tianji Pavilion token from his chest and handing it over: 'Is senior sister referring to this? This disciple also doesn't know what it is, only felt it had some age to it, so brought it back casually.' Su Qingyao took the token, her pupils constricting sharply—the moment the words 'Tianji Pavilion' met her eyes, her entire body froze.

text.content: Tianji Pavilion..." Su Qingyao murmured these three words, her voice carrying an imperceptible tremor. She drew a deep breath, returning the token to Chen Ji, her gaze complex and unreadable. 'You'd better hide this well.' Chen Ji 'obediently' nodded, but as he received the token, his fingertips inadvertently brushed Su Qingyao's palm. A faint Heavenly Secrets aura spread from the point of contact; Su Qingyao shuddered, and a blurry image flashed through her mind—endless blood-colored light, a youth holding a sword, the sword tip pointing straight at the heavens, his eyes showing unprecedented resolve and madness. She abruptly stepped back, gripping the corridor pillar, fine beads of cold sweat forming at her temples. 'Senior sister?' Chen Ji, wearing a concerned expression, leaned closer, 'Are you alright? Your complexion is so pale...' Su Qingyao狠狠瞪了他一眼，转身便走，背影却透着几分仓皇。走出数丈，她的声音才幽幽传来：'三月初七之前，到我洞府来一趟。有些事……我需要当面问你。'话音落下，人已消失在晨雾之中。陈机望着她远去的背影，眸色渐深——苏青瑶，你到底看到了什么？

dialogue.content: Just then, a hidden spiritual sense wave transmitted into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—it was Ye Qing's aura. 'Urgent intelligence.' Her voice carried unprecedented gravity, 'The Demonic Path commander is about to make a major move. In three days, the Holy Sect will mobilize entirely, their target... Tianqing Sect.' Chen Ji's footsteps continued as he sent his spiritual sense in reply: 'Specific details.' Ye Qing's voice grew urgent: 'It is said the Holy Lord obtained an ancient relic that can break through Tianqing Sect's protective mountain formation. And your sister Chen Nian is the key sacrificial offering to activate this relic!' Chen Ji's footsteps abruptly stopped. The surrounding turmoil seemed to fade away instantly; he only felt something burning fiercely in his chest—rage, anxiety, and a nearly mad killing intent. March 7th, Holy Sect sacrificial ceremony. Chen Nian, as the offering, would be pushed onto the altar, activating that ancient relic with the power of Heavenly Fate's Key, completely opening Tianqing Sect's lifeline. And at that time, everyone would think Chen Ji was still in the sect being his废物杂役. No one would have expected that three months ago, he had already begun laying plans. No one would have expected that he had already planted chess pieces within the Holy Sect. No one would have expected—how long he had been waiting for this day.

text.content: Ye Qing's spiritual sense transmitted again, this time carrying a hint of probing: 'What do you plan to do? With your current strength, rushing into the Holy Sect is no different from seeking death.' Chen Ji did not immediately answer. He raised his head, gazing at Tianqing Sect's majestic mountain gate, at the layered clouds and mist, at the countless watching eyes hidden behind the mist. Suddenly, he smiled. That smile was gentle and harmless, even appearing somewhat foolish, but at an angle visible to no one, his eyes had become a deep, cold abyss. 'Three days... is enough.' His voice was soft, yet carried a terrifying certainty, 'Pass my order to the chess pieces within the Holy Sect. Within three days, I want to know the complete procedures of the sacrificial ceremony, guard distributions, and the exact location of that ancient relic.' Ye Qing was silent for a moment: 'You intend to...' 'I want the Holy Sect to understand,' Chen Ji spoke word by word, his voice repressing a massive fury, 'what fate awaits those who touch people of Chen Ji.' Before the words even finished, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly quivered violently. An imposing and cold voice exploded in the depths of his Mental Sea—'Time is running short, Chen Ji. The fate of the Heavenly Fate's Key has begun to turn. You only have ninety days. After ninety days, if she dies, all your schemes will turn to ashes.' Heavenly Dao's Eye!

Chen Ji stood in place, allowing that voice to echo in his Mental Sea. Heavenly Dao's Eye, this terrifying existence above all, had now proactively engaged in dialogue with him. He understood this meant Chen Nian's fate had grown even more entangled with the Tianji Record. Ninety days. He silently recited in his heart, yet the corner of his mouth hooked a mocking arc. Heavenly Dao's Eye said 'only ninety days,' but what it failed to mention—within these ninety days, he could make the entire world tremble. 'Mo Xiansheng.' He called out in his heart. The first page of the Tianji Record glowed faintly, and Mo Xiansheng's aged figure emerged, his voice hoarse: 'What does the Young Master command?' 'Three things.' Chen Ji raised three fingers. 'First, help me deduce all variables of the Holy Sect's sacrificial ceremony. Second, unseal a page of the Tianji Record's knowledge—I want to know the weaknesses of that ancient relic. Third—' He paused, a fierce light flickering in his eyes, 'Tell me what that old scoundrel Ling Yuan has been up to recently.' Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: 'This old servant can only tell you a partial answer regarding the third matter. Ling Yuan has frequently entered and exited the sect's Forbidden Grounds recently, seemingly searching for some sealed ancient object.' Chen Ji narrowed his eyes: 'Ancient object?' 'Precisely.' Mo Xiansheng's voice grew even lower, 'As this old servant knows, that object and the Tianji Record... originated from the same hand.'

The same hand?' Chen Ji's gaze flashed; countless thoughts raced through his mind. The creator of the Tianji Record, the orchestrator of Heavenly Dao's Eye's layout, and the legendary Tianji Pavilion... all of this seemed to point toward some unfathomable existence. And Ling Yuan, that old fox, was now coveting something related to the Tianji Record—was he seeking more powerful strength, or wanting to completely destroy the Tianji Record's legacy? Either way, Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. This old thing was more dangerous than he imagined. 'It seems the plan needs to change.' He murmured to himself, turning toward his servants' quarters. Along the way, disciples continued pointing and laughing at him, their mockery unceasing. 'Look, that's the废物 who happened to stumble into the top three.' 'Hmph, probably cheated—wait for it to be exposed.' 'Do you think that ragged fellow has any treasures worth mentioning?' Chen Ji heard nothing, his pace steady. The moment he crossed the threshold into the small room, he suddenly stopped, glancing back at the disciples mocking him, his gaze terrifyingly calm. 'Honored senior brothers,' he suddenly spoke, his voice not loud but clearly reaching everyone's ears, 'The Sect Tournament in three days—this disciple also wishes to participate.届时还请诸位……手下留情。'说完，他便转身进了屋，留下身后一片哄笑。废物要挑战他们？简直是自取其辱！

text.content: Ye Qing's spiritual sense wave transmitted, carrying a hint of surprise: 'Are you certain you want to expose your strength at the Sect Tournament? This contradicts your usual low-profile strategy.' Chen Ji sat cross-legged on the简陋床榻, eyes closed in meditation: 'The Holy Sect moves in three days; the Sect Tournament is the best cover.' He paused, a cold smile curving his lips, 'Besides, some跳梁小丑 have been蹦跶得 too happily lately. It's time they understood what it means to—know their place.'

choices.text: Feigning weakness to吃掉老虎, hiding until the end
choices.description: Continue hiding strength, pretend close victories or narrow defeats in the tournament, maintain废物人设, secretly observe reactions from various forces.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rippled slightly: 'The path of hiding weakness, this old servant actually agrees. Young Master's foundations are not yet stable; exposing too early will only attract unnecessary trouble.' Chen Ji微微点头, yet a sharp light flickered in his eyes: 'It's not just about hiding weakness.' He took out the Tianji Pavilion token from his chest, gently stroking it, 'I want to use this tournament to force out some people's底牌.'

choices.text: Secretly set a trap, lure the guest into the jar

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes, gazing at the darkening sky outside the window. "That idiot Han Lie should have returned to the sect by now, right?" he murmured to himself, a meaningful smile curling his lips. "He escaped last time in the秘境. This time... I'd like to see how much pride the genius of Xuanwu Sect has left."

Just then, hurried footsteps came from outside the door. "Chen Ji! Are you in there!" It was Zhou Dazhuang's voice, who shared the servants' quarters with him. Chen Ji frowned, rose and opened the door, only to find Zhou Dazhuang standing outside, drenched in sweat and appearing terrified. "What's wrong?" he asked, his tone carrying just the right amount of panic. Zhou Dazhuang grabbed his arm, his voice trembling: "It's bad! Han Lie! Han Lie brought people! He says he's here to settle a score with you!" Chen Ji's heart stirred. Gazing over Zhou Dazhuang's shoulder, he saw more than a dozen people standing not far away. The leading youth had a sturdy build, his resolute features carrying a hint of ruthlessness—he was precisely Han Lie, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect. Behind him followed several Tianqing Sect disciples, one of whom Chen Ji recognized—the Senior Brother Li he had thoroughly humiliated in the秘境. Han Lie strode forward, his gaze slicing into Chen Ji like a blade. His voice was cold and hard: "Waste, I heard you made quite a spectacle in the秘境? Today, let me see what you're capable of!"

dialogue.content: Han Lie looked down at Chen Ji from above, emanating an oppressive aura. He was the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect—merely twenty years old yet already broken through to late Foundation Building, his combat power sufficient to challenge Golden Core experts across ranks. In his eyes, Chen Ji was nothing more than an ant with decent luck, not worth even a proper glance. "What, scared?" he sneered. "Trash is trash, can't even speak?" The crowd gathered around grew thicker, voices murmuring endlessly. "Isn't that Han Lie from Xuanwu Sect? Why did he come to Tianqing Sect?" "I heard he's here to settle a score with that trash." "There's going to be a good show now, that trash might get beaten to a cripple." Chen Ji kept his head bowed, his shoulders trembling slightly, looking utterly terrified. But in his lowered eyes lay an abyss-like cold abyss. Han Lie, you've come at the perfect time. I was just worried I wouldn't have a chance to establish my prestige, and here you've delivered yourself to my door.

choice.prompt: Han Lie publicly challenged him, Chen Ji must respond:

choices.text: Retreat to advance, feign weakness to lure the enemy
choices.description: Continue pretending to be timid and cowardly, let Han Lie lower his guard, then defeat the strong with the weak before everyone, the face-slapping effect multiplied.
choices.visible_cost: Public humiliation, temporary loss of face
choices.visible_reward: A crucial reversal at the key moment, the sense of satisfaction doubled
choices.risk_hint: If Han Lie doesn't step onto the field, the face-slapping cannot be completed
choices.process_label: 让敌人小瞧你，然后狠狠打脸

text.content: Chen Ji "thudded" to his knees on the ground, voice trembling: "Han... Han Senior Brother, spare my life! The disciple only had good luck, how would I dare oppose Senior Brother!" His forehead pressed tightly to the ground, posture at the lowest possible humility. Scornful laughter erupted all around. "Hahaha, truly trash, doesn't even dare resist." "Han Senior Brother, just teach him a lesson, don't dirty your hands." Han Lie coldly snorted, kicking Chen Ji on the shoulder, sending him sprawling. "Spineless creature, get lost!" Chen Ji curled on the ground, groaning in pain, yet a cold gleam flickered in the corner of his eye—Han Lie, every kick you land on me today, I will make you repay a hundredfold tomorrow.

choices.text: Confront directly, counterattack on the spot
choices.description: No more toleration, crush Han Lie directly with strength, let everyone witness the true power of this 'trash,' one battle shakes the entire sect.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing strength too early, attracting attention from all sides
choices.visible_reward: Reputation soars, the face-slapping effect is shocking
choices.risk_hint: May draw Ling Yuan's special attention

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up, brushing the dust from his clothes. He still kept his head bowed, his voice terrifyingly calm: "If Senior Brother Han wishes to spar, the disciple shall gladly comply." Before the words even finished, he abruptly raised his head, eyes blazing with brilliant light. Han Lie's pupils contracted, instinctively stepping back half a pace—in that instant, he felt an aura from Chen Ji that made one's heart palpitate with fear, as if a slumbering dragon had opened its eyes. "You—" Before Han Lie could finish, Chen Ji had already moved. No fancy techniques whatsoever, just a simple punch thrown out. Yet this single punch caused everyone's expression to change. The拳 wind howled, carrying a force of destruction, rushing straight for Han Lie's face!

choices.text: Use a knife to kill, draw out the snake
choices.description: Deliberately provoke Han Lie into attacking first, then counterattack under the name of "legitimate defense," which not only occupies the moral high ground but also allows a justified lesson to the opponent.
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise rhythm control, higher risk
choices.visible_reward: Occupies the righteous name, no one can find fault
choices.risk_hint: If Han Lie restrains himself and doesn't strike, the plan fails
choices.process_label: 让敌人主动犯错，然后堂堂正正地反击

text.content: A faint smirk tugged at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, revealing a barely perceptible sneer. He deliberately lowered his voice, ensuring only Han Lie could hear: "I heard Senior Brother Han fled in terror from a 'trash' inside the秘境? Tsk tsk, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect is也不过如此嘛." Han Lie instantly flew into a rage, eyes crimson: "What did you say!" He raised his palm, about to strike Chen Ji. However, just as his palm was about to touch Chen Ji, the latter suddenly "slipped on his feet," tumbling backward while screaming in "terror": "Senior Brother Han, spare my life! The disciple dares not!" His acting was impeccable, so perfect that everyone witnessed the scene of a trash being bullied by a genius. Han Lie's slap froze mid-air, his face ashen—but Chen Ji had already "fainted."

"Chen Ji was 'rescued' back to the Servants' Quarters, with Zhou Dazhuang and several Servant Disciples crowding around his bed, faces full of worry. 'Chen Ji, are you alright? Han Lie is way too arrogant, actually daring to run wild in our Tianqing Sect!' Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, his expression haggard as he coughed twice: 'I'm... I'm fine.' He struggled to sit up, looking weak and powerless. 'It's just that... my internal organs were all injured. It'll probably take a long time to recover.' Zhou Dazhuang indignantly asked: 'Are you just going to let this go? Why not report him to the Law Enforcement Hall?' Chen Ji shook his head with a bitter smile: 'Han Lie is a genius from Xuanwu Sect, and I'm just a Servant Disciple. How could I possibly sue him? Forget it, I'll just endure it.' As he spoke, a cold light flickered in the corner of his eye—this debt, he had recorded. In three days at the Sect Competition, he would settle the score with interest."

dialogue.content: "Late at night, silence blankets the Servants' Quarters. Chen Ji sat cross-legged on his bed, the Tianji Record Fragment hovering before him, emanating a faint cyan glow. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from the pages, his weathered face appearing ethereal beneath the moonlight. 'Young Master, what precisely prompted your actions today?' he inquired, his voice tinged with bewilderment. A subtle smile played across Chen Ji's lips as he responded: 'Master, how far do you believe the news of my beating by Han Lie will spread?' Mo Xiansheng reflected momentarily: 'Given Han Lie's reputation, this matter will inevitably circulate throughout the three major Sects within three days.' Chen Ji nodded in agreement: 'Precisely. A waste of a servant being publicly assaulted by the Xuanwu Sect's top genius—this information surpasses any form of publicity.' He paused, a cunning glint dancing in his eyes. 'On the third day of the Sect Competition, I will appear as the 'victim'. Regardless of who I face, I will hold the moral high ground. And Han Lie—' A cold smirk crossed his face. 'The more arrogant he becomes, the more ammunition he provides me.'"

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng stroked his long beard, admiration flickering in his gaze: 'Young Master, your strategic depth is impressive. However—' His tone shifted. 'Han Lie possesses formidable Combat Power. In the Sect Competition, what's your actual confidence in defeating him?' Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, gently touching the Tianji Record Fragment. A subtle prediction information coursed through his mind—in three days, his first opponent would be Senior Brother Li, with Han Lie following. Yet in the Tianji Record's prophecy, Han Lie's face twisted in disbelief. Chen Ji's lips curved upward: 'Ten chances out of ten.' Mo Xiansheng blinked, then burst into laughter: 'Excellent! Magnificent! I shall witness how you make those who underestimated you pay the price!'"

"At that moment, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently. A cold, authoritative voice resonated within Chen Ji's Mental Sea—'Chen Ji, you think you're playing chess, yet you yourself are merely a chess piece.' The Eye of Heavenly Secrets! Chen Ji's heart tensed, yet he remained composed. He calmly inquired: 'Since I'm already a chess piece, who is the true Chess Player?' The Eye of Heavenly Secrets paused, its voice growing increasingly chilling: 'Some believe you can alter destiny. Some consider you merely a tool. And you—' The voice dripped with contempt. 'Are simply making a final desperate struggle on a destined-to-collapse chessboard.' Chen Ji's eyes sharpened: 'Destined to collapse?' 'In three months, heaven and earth will transform.届时，你所珍视的一切，都将化为乌有。' The voice gradually faded, leaving only the final words reverberating in his Mental Sea: 'And you still have a choice—whether to continue this destined-to-fail game, or... end everything prematurely.'"

choice.prompt: "The warning from the Eye of Heavenly Secrets has intensified the urgency of the situation, and Chen Ji must make a choice:"

choices.description: "Do not wait for the third month. Act now. Infiltrate the Holy Sect in advance, rescue Chen Nian before the ritual begins, and disrupt the enemy's entire plan."
choices.visible_reward: "Disrupt the enemy's rhythm, seize the initiative"
choices.risk_hint: "Once failed, all layouts will be completely exposed"
choices.process_label: 以攻代守，抢占命运先机

text.content: "Chen Ji stood up, his eyes burning with fierce fighting intent: 'The Eye of Heavenly Secrets says I'm destined to fail? Then I'll prove it wrong—fate can be rewritten!' He turned to Mo Xiansheng. 'Master, unseal the second page of the Tianji Record. I need more complete information to plan this thorny path.'"

choices.description: "Proceed as originally planned, use three months to accumulate more筹码. Establish prestige at the Sect Competition in three days, while secretly contacting various forces, wait patiently for the opportune moment."
choices.risk_hint: "The enemy may complete their layout during this period"
choices.process_label: 步步为营，以时间换空间

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, temporarily suppressing the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' warning. He took a deep breath, his voice calm yet firm: 'Haste breeds change, patience controls people. Three months, I am confident.' He opened his eyes, cold light flickering within. 'During these three months, I will let the entire world know—on Chen Ji's chessboard, there are no useless pieces.'"

choices.description: "On the surface, participate in the Sect Competition as scheduled; secretly, activate Ye Qing's chess pieces. Two preparations, advance can attack, retreat can defend."
choices.visible_cost: "Need to maintain two lines simultaneously, significant energy consumption"
choices.visible_reward: "Free to advance or retreat, offensively and defensively balanced"
choices.risk_hint: "If either line is exposed, it will implicate the other"

text.content: "Chen Ji let out a cold laugh: 'The Eye of Heavenly Secrets wants to shake my will through fear? Unfortunately, it chose the wrong target.' He turned to gaze at the night sky beyond the window, his eyes reflecting the scattered starlight. 'In the competition three days later, I will let everyone see the rise of waste Chen Ji. As for Chen Nian—' His voice was low and dangerous. 'The Holy Sect thinks they've seized my weakness, but they don't realize—she is my greatest trump card.'"

"Over the next three days, while Chen Ji 'recovered' in the Servants' Quarters, he secretly contacted Ye Qing's chess pieces arranged within the Holy Sect. Messages flowed in like water: the ritual location confirmed at the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds 'Blood Moon Altar'; the guard forces even more strictly fortified than anticipated; the ancient relic named 'Sky-Breaking Lock', requiring the blood of the Heavenly Fate Key to unlock, forcibly breaking through all formation protections. And Chen Nian was precisely the chosen Heavenly Fate Key. More critically—the Sect Master himself would personally preside over the ritual on the third day of the third month. This meant all of the Holy Sect's high-end combat power would be concentrated near the altar. If a sudden strike could be launched at that moment... A gleam of sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. This wasn't recklessness—this was a rare opportunity. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul watched quietly from the side, then suddenly spoke: 'Young Master, what are you smiling about?' Chen Ji收敛笑容，站起身来活动了一下筋骨：'我在笑……命运的剧本，似乎正在按我想要的方向发展。'

"Three days passed in a flash. The Sect Competition arrived as scheduled, and the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena was packed with people. Nearly all the important figures from the three major Sects were present. Chen Ji mixed among the Servant Disciples, looking docile as he stood at the very end of the line, seeming to have no ambitions whatsoever. Yet his spiritual sense had already spread across the entire venue, capturing every subtle movement. Above on the high platform, Elder Ling Yuan sat regally in the main seat, his expression kind yet hiding sharp keenness within his eyes. Su Qingyao, as the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, was responsible for presiding over the competition's procedures. Han Lie sat in Xuanwu Sect's observation area, his gaze occasionally sweeping toward Chen Ji's direction, a contemptuous smile hanging on his lips. And in some unremarkable corner of the crowd, Chen Ji sensed a familiar aura—Ye Qing, she had actually come personally. Chen Ji slightly tilted his head, briefly intersecting with that aura, as if an invisible understanding flowed between the two. Everything was prepared. Su Qingyao's voice echoed across the competition grounds: 'The Sect Competition officially begins!'"

The first round of the Sect Tournament was a general selection, with Servant Disciples and Outer Disciples mixed in battle, winners advancing. Chen Ji lost without any suspense—at least, that's how it appeared to everyone. He was slapped flying by an Outer Disciple, falling miserably off the Arena Platform, blood spurting from his mouth. "Waste is still waste!" the Outer Disciple gloated mockingly. "Still dreaming of turning your life around? Try next life!" Chen Ji curled up on the ground, trembling all over, as if scared out of his wits. A burst of mocking laughter erupted around him. Even Ling Yuan, the old Sect Master, slightly shook his head, seeming utterly disappointed in him. Yet no one saw the icy smile spreading in the depths of Chen Ji's downcast eyes. Go ahead and laugh. Later, I won't even let you cry. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea: "Young Master, everything is ready. The second page of the Tianji Record has been unsealed. You may begin."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, wiping away the blood from the corner of his mouth. His movements were slow, like an injured beast licking its wounds. However, just as everyone thought he had completely given up, he suddenly raised his head, his gaze sweeping across the entire crowd like lightning. "First round Servant Disciple group, advancement list confirmed." Su Qingyao's voice rang out, "Chen Ji, defeated, eliminated from the next round—" Wait. "A cold voice interrupted her. Everyone turned to look, only to see Chen Ji step onto the Arena Platform one step at a time, though his steps were unsteady, he carried an aura that chilled the heart. His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears: "This disciple wishes to apply for a rematch." The entire arena erupted in an uproar. The rematch was a special rule in the Sect Tournament—losers could challenge already-advancing contestants, with the winner taking their position. But this rule was almost never used, because challengers often ended up losing even more miserably. Su Qingyao frowned slightly: "Do you know the rules of the rematch?" Chen Ji nodded, a faint smile curling at his lips: "This disciple wishes to challenge... Brother Li." The words fell, and Brother Li's face instantly turned ashen.

text.content: Brother Li was precisely the person Chen Ji had cruelly humiliated in the secret realm that day. Hearing Chen Ji call him out by name, his face shifted between green and white, before finally gritting his teeth and stepping onto the Arena Platform. "You waste, you're looking for death!" he gnashed his teeth, palms filled with spiritual energy, lunging directly at Chen Ji. This palm strike, he used ten percent of his strength, vowing to kill Chen Ji in one blow. However, Chen Ji merely shifted his body gently, and that fierce attack grazed past his ear. At the same time, a hand gently pressed against Brother Li's chest—it was Chen Ji. "You—" Brother Li's pupils constricted sharply, before he could finish speaking, a force like mountains and seas exploded from his chest. He flew backward like a kite with its string cut, crashing heavily at the edge of the Arena Platform, vomiting blood and unable to even crawl. The entire arena fell into dead silence. Those who had just been ridiculing Chen Ji were now all staring wide-eyed, faces filled with disbelief. That waste... actually defeated Brother Li with a single palm? Han Lie rose abruptly, his expression gloomy enough to drip water. Chen Ji turned his head, his gaze meeting Han Lie's正好. Those eyes were calm as water, yet they made Han Lie feel a bone-deep chill—as if being stared at by some primordial beast.

"Excellent! Excellent display of a waste turning the tables!" At the high platform, a white-haired elder suddenly burst into laughter, clapping his hands. Everyone turned to look—it was Xuanwu Sect Elder Han Lao, Han Lie's great-uncle. He stroked his beard, eyes full of appreciation. "This kid is interesting, actually hiding himself so deep." Ling Yuan the old Sect Master's eyes narrowed slightly, his gaze lingering on Chen Ji for a moment before moving away indifferently. Only he himself knew that in that instant, a strong killing intent had surged in his heart. This servant disciple... was no simple matter. Su Qingyao stood on the high platform, gazing at Chen Ji with complex eyes. She finally understood why that day's prophecy had been so blurry—this "waste" she had ignored for three years was fundamentally a wolf in sheep's clothing. "Rematch, Chen Ji wins." Her voice was calm, yet carried an undetectable tremor. "Advancing to the next round." Whispers erupted through the crowd, everyone speculating how much strength this waste still had hidden. And Chen Ji merely lowered his head slightly, returning to the servant disciples' ranks, as if nothing had happened. But at an angle no one could see, his gaze had already passed over the crowd, landing on a familiar direction—where Ye Qing's aura was quietly retreating. A faint smile curved at Chen Ji's lips. The show... has just begun. The three-month countdown officially starts. On the seventh day of the third month, he would let the entire world witness a miracle capable of shaking fate itself.
